description: Manages user-specific settings and preferences, primarily focusing on the default organizational unit for filtering and access control.

endpoints.name: GetDefaultOrgUnit
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's default organizational unit preference for filtering and access control. This preference determines the user's default context for operations and data visibility.
example_uses: Get my default organizational unit setting
What's my default org unit preference?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when loading user's default organizational unit for filtering or when determining the user's default office context.

endpoints.name: SetDefaultOrgUnit
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's default organizational unit preference for filtering and access control. This allows users to change their primary working context.

request.description: Default org unit request containing the new setting

example_uses: Set my default org unit to Headquarters
Change my default office to Field Office 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to change their default organizational unit for filtering and access control purposes.
